newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-No sale in Australian Wheat Board tender.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-No sale in Australian Wheat Board tender.

text.p: The Australian Wheat Board (AWB) said there were no successful bids in the latest national pool tender.
The total amount bid for was 6,500 tonnes of old crop wheat, it said.

Highest failed bids were for Australian Standard White (ASW) in Geelong at A$184.00 a tonne for July delivery, ASW in Geelong at A$182.00 for April delivery, and for Australian Hard1 in Fremantle at A$212.00 a tonne for July delivery.
Closing date for the next tender is March 19.
